title: A repeated Joomla fact row (branch city and address, team member, client, counter) is filled whole from evidence or kept demo
steps: S1: Plan and apply tracy-business/j6 with a description that mentions Dubai and a model that writes "Dubai" into the three Contact - Branches city cells.
S2: Same, with "Dubai" written into every city and addr cell of the Branches rows.
S3: Same, with a description naming one branch whole (city, address with phone) and a second city alone.
S4: Run partialFactRows over the newest Branches module, a site identity module and jatable team rows.
expect: S1: no Branches city or addr cell is written; the rows keep the demo.
S2: no Branches cell is written: one value in the same field of several rows is one fact.
S3: the named branch's city and address are written; the city without an address is not.
S4: the Branches module is three city+addr rows, the heading is no row, the site identity is no row, a team row missing its role is dropped.
evidence: 14/10/2026 acceptance of #1331 on dev, site g66-accept-tbjoomla (Tracy Business Joomla 1.2.3): /en/contact Branches rows read "Dubai: 7/22 Derbenevskaya emb., 8th floor", "Dubai: Lipetsk SEZ, 6 Tekhnologichesky proezd", "Dubai: Fabrication yard, Zavolzhye IP"; each gated cell was judged alone and "Dubai" is a verbatim piece of the brief.
fence: The real tracy-business/j6 map, the seeder's real planner, a model double and a site double; no site is built.
